get_classes_coco: get the COCO dataset class names by calling get_classes with the dataset name 'coco'
get_classes_voc: get the Pascal VOC dataset class names by calling get_classes with the dataset name 'voc'
get_classes_cityscapes: get the Cityscapes dataset class names by calling get_classes with the dataset name 'cityscapes'
coco_classes_list: get the full list of 80 COCO object detection class labels by calling coco_classes
voc_classes_list: get the full list of 20 Pascal VOC object detection class labels by calling voc_classes
